additional_concerns: Exposure measurement and asset classification are supplied judgments, not implemented calculations. The representation therefore preserves the classification logic conditionally on those inputs; it does not establish their correctness.

Footnote 7 states: “In cases where the Fund’s aggregate direct and indirect exposures to private market assets are less than 50% of the Fund’s NAV.” The designation input does not expressly encode this context. The OR structure preserves the known-input result because exposure at or above 50% independently suffices; it does not implement the SFC’s designation assessment.

The assessment-time convention does not establish a source-derived measurement date, persistence rule or declassification rule. An operative designation requires evidence of its effect at the chosen time.

Blocking evaluation for any conflicting dependency, including an otherwise unnecessary branch, is an evidentiary runtime policy rather than a rule stated by the circular. It can withhold a result despite an independently established classification route.
The supplied missing dependency IDs have no identifying metadata linking them to particular external authorities. No catalogue mapping can be established from this packet.
